text:
The Lake Wind Advisory is up, so the waterfront is no place for a casual paddle today. Northwest winds at 15 to 25 knots will push waves to 3 to 5 feet before easing, while Burlington stays cloudy to start, then turns partly sunny. A stray shower may hang on into midday, but the bigger story is the cold and wind, with a high only around 44 and gusts near 30 mph. Dress for wind chills in the 30s, even once the sun breaks through.

Tonight clears quickly and drops to around 31. Sunday is the payoff, sunny and much milder with a high near 55, though a south wind around 10 mph will keep the lake a little active. I’d keep waterfront plans close to shore today, and wait for Sunday if you want a comfortable outing on or beside the water.
